newsitem.title: USA: US rate hike seen aiding value stocks -Barron's.
newsitem.headline: US rate hike seen aiding value stocks -Barron's.

text.p: Small-cap value investors said that even if the Federal Reserve were to raise interest rates this summer, their portfolios may not be hurt, and may even be helped, Barron's financial weekly reported.

"I haven't got a clue (what the Fed will do)," Martin Whitman of Third Avenue Value Fund told the financial weekly in its June 2 edition. "But I think our portfolio would generally be a big beneficiary of higher rates, because they're cash-rich companies."
"If you get an environment where your competitor's costs go up and yours don't, you've benefited."

Chuck Royce of Royce Value Fund said that higher rates on a relative basis "are a positive factor because high-multiple investing almost demands lower interest rates or a change in interest rates coming down."
"So I think we have a good period here for interest rates vis-a-vis stock selection - as opposed to momentum-style investing."
Among the stocks Whitman mentioned are Carver Bancorp, T exas Micro Inc and Stewart Information Services Corp.
Royce liked Frozen Food Express Industries Inc, Basset Furniture Industries Inc and Sevenson Environmental Services Inc, among others.
Among the stocks cited by David Schafer of Strong Schafer Value Fund were New Holland Mining NL, Harman International Industries Inc and Borg-Warner Automotive Inc.
